notes.title: Update The Santa Challenge
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the release of the The Santa Challenge, our first Steam game, in 2019, we collected a lot of feedback about the game and wanted to address the most important ones for 2020!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/8a3fcb529e4cfca13f5a312eb30674980ccf87f2.jpg

Here are the changes:
- Picture #3 has been changed for a new one (too dark)
- We changed the timer last update to make it count up instead of count down so players not interested to do medals and best chrono can play at the speed they want. Those players can now also hide the chrono and medals info with a checkbox displayed at the bottom left corner.
- Added 3 new musics to the pool.
- Fullscreen/Windowed is now more adaptable
- Mute button now stop only the music not the SFX, SFX can still be turn down or off in the Settings in main menu.
- Christmas count down will start December 1st until December 24th.
- Text sizes have been adjusted on main menu.
- Rollover in the level selection now work as intended. No more bugs.. I hope..
(-MJA promo has been removed on my main menu)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/9f1e2fb18eb4e7b3448ad4eca412fd7d2e1a9dff.jpg

Personal note:
Since the release of The Santa Challenge, we released 9 games in 2020!!!
We really want to thank you for all for your support especially the testers on Discord, people spreading the words on Twitter/Facebook/Instagram/Reddit every update or release or just players buying our games! Leaving my day job to be an indie developer fulltime was an hard decision but it's now an incredible journey! Thank you!
To celebrate Christmas coming we will organize events on social media, don't hesitate to join us to not missed them > https://twitter.com/coldcoffeegames

notes.title: Update 1.1 : Features / Improvements / Bug Fixs
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle lovers,
It's Ben from Cold Coffee Studio !

First of all, we wish you a Merry Christmas and an amazing upcoming 2020.ːsteamhappyː

The Santa Challenge has been released one week ago with the objective to offer a nice and cool gameplay for people interested to enjoy a nice moment or looking for a good challenge.
We received a lot of feedback after the release on Discord and Twitter on many elements (UI, challenge, medals, timer, size of puzzles, menus...).
We ordered each elements and integrated them in the roadmap, then we focused on critical  improvements you requested the most.

Update 1.1: 
MAJOR CHANGES
 Timer : We removed the timer in puzzle to change it for a chrono. You are not limited in time anymore to complete a puzzle but if you complete a puzzle fast, you can still win medals.
 Puzzle options: You can now hide the grid and/or hide the black&white image. This preferences are saved automatically and kept between puzzles.
 Medals : We add a little extra time to each medals.
 Medals UI : We also add a "help text" in the level selector and in the puzzle screen to remember you the different time to earn medals.
 Twitch : We removed the Twitch feature for now. It seems to complicate for us to maintain the feature while improving the game; it may come back in the future.ːsteamsadː
 Puzzle interface : We reworked the puzzle interface to make the puzzle bigger and working better in small resolution, especially 4/3:  800*600 - 1024*768


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/0bca757f22e5b96b2da97564dfd9c67ae9b85e38.jpg

MINOR CHANGES
 Puzzle buttons (next, previous, mute, leave, restart): Updated with icons and smaller to reduce the focus.
 Scrolling: You can now scroll using your mouse wheel in Puzzle Selection and Gallery !
 Puzzle selector: Reworked - 2 rows !
 Credits: Reworked - Added supporters !
 Main menu: Changed some social media icons.
 Helps in Puzzle Selector: added two helps, one for medal, one for hints.
 Chrono at end: The time you did during the puzzle is displayed at the end.
 Gallery images: Pictures are now unlocked no matter the medal you won. If you completed it, it's unlocked.
 Delete save: You can now delete your save in Options.
 Puzzle 17 (stars on black background) changed to a new one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/1cbfe52911726e7c8129f47a73e5d251b35f89e3.png
BUG FIXES
 Puzzle remaining at end: added a security so it should not happen.
 Pieces over pieces: When you drag a puzzle piece, it will always come in front of the others, but will go behind when you release. Another fix will come later to improve this system.
 Grid over piece puzzles: Grid will always be behind pieces.
 Windowed mode: works as intend, you can resize the window if necessary.
 Click area: Click area in Puzzle Selector and Gallery is now the size of the image.
 Chrono 4:60 : Chrono now displays 5:00 instead of 4:60.
 Options button bugged: solved
 Social network buttons were pixelized : solved

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/8a3fcb529e4cfca13f5a312eb30674980ccf87f2.jpg
KNOWN BUGS
 Selected pieces may pass behind the puzzle already place on the puzzle. Fix 1/2.
 Puzzles may not resize or disapear if you are in windowed and change resolution during game.
 Old save remains after the upload so you may have pieces not well placed in the puzzle (because position of each pieces is saved). Please restart puzzle to fix the issue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36245886/9f1e2fb18eb4e7b3448ad4eca412fd7d2e1a9dff.jpg
